versions.description: Owner-requested widening (not a threshold/quality change to the existing 4 buckets). Leaders' sustained-strength core grew 8 -> 11 (leader_ss_slots), so more mid-timeframe leaders land in the stable core instead of relying on the smaller freshness fill or lower-priority buckets to surface them. New 5th bucket, all_green (all_green_slots=4, LOWEST priority — fills last, after rs_new_high, with the same tag-in-place + backfill-past-N dedup policy as emerging/accel/rs_new_high): a group qualifies if perf_week, perf_month, perf_quarter, perf_half, and perf_ytd (raw group perf, not vs. SPY) are ALL positive, ranked by momentum_score desc (chosen over momentum_confirmed — the gate itself already screens for cross-timeframe consistency, so ranking by raw strength differentiates within that already-consistent set better than re-applying a strength x agreement discount would). Because all_green is lowest priority, a group that would also qualify for a higher bucket is claimed there first; all_green only ever picks up groups nothing else wanted. daily_group_cap raised 20 -> 27, the exact worst-case sum of every bucket's slots (11+2+4+3+3+4) so a fully-packed day fills every bucket to its promised size with no truncation. global_fetch_cap (page budget) was deliberately NOT raised to match — see picks_config.py comment on GLOBAL_FETCH_CAP for the resulting zero-headroom tradeoff on a fully-packed day.

params.all_green_gate: perf_week>0 AND perf_month>0 AND perf_quarter>0 AND perf_half>0 AND perf_ytd>0

versions.description: Backfill fix for bucket dedup (ADR-007 amendment). A group already selected by a higher-priority bucket is still tagged when it ranks in a lower-priority bucket's natural top-N (attribution preserved, unchanged from v1), but no longer consumes one of that bucket's N slots just by appearing there: emerging/accel/rs_new_high now backfill past rank N with the next NEW (not-yet-selected) candidate, so each bucket's N slots still yield N distinct groups whenever the qualifying pool is deep enough. Leaders' freshness-fill sub-bucket already excluded the core 8 by construction (unchanged). All slot counts, gate thresholds, and rank metrics are unchanged from v1 — this is a fill-order change, not a threshold change.

Initial picks selector (Phase 2). Four-bucket priority-fill (cap 20 unique groups/day): leaders = 8 sustained_strength (lowest sum of rank_month+rank_quarter+rank_half) + 2 freshness fills (momentum_confirmed desc, not already in core); emerging = regime_short_long > 0.15 AND rs_score > 0.5 (sort regime_short_long desc); accel = momentum_accel > 0.08 AND top-40% by momentum_score AND rs_score > 0.5 (sort momentum_accel desc); rs_new_high = rs_new_high == 1 AND rs_score >= 0.6 AND top-40% by momentum_score (sort rs_slope desc). Anti-flash floor is a cross-sectional momentum_score percentile (top 40%), invariant to formula rescaling. VP-locked 2026-06-24/25; see ADR-007.
